name: crimes-monorepo
description: A crime scene investigator for your codebase. Built for agents, readable by humans.
author: Andrew Mayfield

scripts.test: pnpm -r run test && python3 scripts/eval-outcomes.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p "test_*.py"
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.scan:example: pnpm --filter crimes build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js scan examples/messy-ts-app
scripts.scan:example:json: pnpm --filter crimes build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js scan examples/messy-ts-app --format json
scripts.docs:generate: node scripts/generate-reference.mjs && node scripts/generate-api-types.mjs && node scripts/sync-skills.mjs
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/generate-reference.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-api-types.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-skills.mjs --check
